data: Uttar Pradesh State Road Transport Corporation (UPSRTC) has released notification for Bus Conductor Recruitment 2026. This recruitment is being conducted through outsourcing mode. Candidates who have passed 10+2 and CCC certificate are eligible to apply.

Important Dates:
• Application Start: Already Started
• Last Date: District Wise (07–09 April 2026)
• Merit / Selection: As per schedule

Application Fee:
• General / OBC / SC / ST: ₹0 (No Fee)

Age Limit:
• Minimum: 18 Years
• Maximum: 40 Years
• Age relaxation as per rules

Eligibility:
• 10+2 Intermediate Pass
• CCC Computer Certificate Required
Important Note: This is an outsourcing job, not a permanent government job. Salary and benefits may be lower compared to regular UPSRTC employees.
